name: GWND Fulfillment – Order Tracking, Packing Slips & Photos
author: Great White North Design

sections.description: Shipment tracking with a branded order status page, packing slips without prices, and packing photos on every order, for WooCommerce stores.
sections.changelog:
1.2.2

Always credited to Great White North Design, and no ShipStation.

Changed

  • The admin credit (Docs & support on the Plugins screen, the mark and credit line on WooCommerce → Fulfillment) always shows. It no longer steps aside for Pro, and the gwnf_show_credit filter is gone. With Pro active it reads "GWND Fulfillment Pro x.y.z by Great White North Design".
  • The menu and page title are fixed as "Fulfillment" (the gwnf_menu_title filter is gone).

Removed

  • Leftover ShipStation code: the "(from ShipStation)" order-note label and gwnot_map_carrier(), which nothing called any more.

Added

  • readme.txt Credits section for the bundled QR code library.

1.2.1

Branded, and kept up to date from GitHub.

Added

  • Plugin icon, banner and screenshots (.wordpress-org/), and the GWND Fulfillment mark (assets/gwnd-mark.svg).
  • Admin-only credit: a Docs & support link on the Plugins screen, and the mark and a credit line on WooCommerce → Fulfillment. Never on the storefront, slips or emails. Hidden while GWND Fulfillment Pro is active (Pro's Branding tab decides), or with add_filter( 'gwnf_show_credit', '__return_false' ).
  • Signed updates from jesssqui/gwn-plugin-releases in the GitHub build (includes/class-gwnf-updater.php, lib/). Steps aside when Pro is loaded, since Pro already updates this plugin. Left out of the WordPress.org build (WPORG=1 bin/build-zip.sh).
  • bin/publish.sh also refreshes the fixed-name download (gwnd-fulfillment/gwnd-fulfillment.zip) the website links to, and ships to WordPress.org when the SVN secrets are set (bin/deploy-wporg.sh).

Changed

  • Plugin URI is now https://greatwhitenorthdesign.ca/tools/fulfillment/.
  • Admin and packing-slip CSS/JS go through wp_add_inline_style / wp_add_inline_script and wp_print_*; no inline onclick.

Fixed

  • Packing slip header: the order number inherited the muted grey of the date below it.

1.2.0

Free edition, ready for WordPress.org. 4×6 and bulk slips move to GWND Fulfillment Pro. Live tracking and the ShipStation bridge are gone for now: tracking links go to the carrier's own page.

Added

  • Look tab: Theme default and Clean styles, logo plus dark-background logo, colours with a contrast check, live preview.
  • Wording & emails tab: every customer-facing line can be changed.
  • Workflow tab: order status page address, help email, carriers offered, what saving tracking does.
  • Packing slip settings move into a Fulfillment tab; slips show who printed them.

Changed

  • Carrier dropdown defaults to auto-detect; tracking entries are easier to read; dashicon instead of an emoji in the orders list.
  • GPL licence, no self-updater; CSS and JS load as files; every string is translatable.

1.1.0

First release of GWND Fulfillment: GWN Order Tracking and GWN Packing Slips in one plugin, for any WooCommerce store.

Added

  • One plugin, two parts. WooCommerce → Fulfillment switches shipment tracking, packing slips and packing photos on or off (or force them with the gwnf_modules filter).
  • Packing photos. A "Packing photos" box on each order: take photos of what's going in the box (opens the camera on a phone, several at once) or upload them. Kept privately with the order — not in the Media Library, only staff who can edit orders can see them. Shrunk to max 2000px with location data removed. Each upload/delete adds an order note; the orders list shows a 📷 count. Photos are removed only if the order is permanently deleted.
  • Live tracking for Canada Post (Developer Portal API key + secret, or the original Developer Program username + password), UPS (OAuth Client ID + Secret) and Purolator (E-Ship web service key). Each shipment's status — label created, in transit, out for delivery, ready for pickup, delivered, delivery problem, returning — shows on the order, as a pill in the orders list, and on the customer's status page with an expected date and the full scan history. Checked every 2–6 hours until delivered (stops after 45 days), with back-off on errors and a "Refresh from carrier" button.
  • Delivery emails (each optional): delivered, ready for pickup / delivery problem, out for delivery. Never sent on a shipment's first check, so switching live tracking on doesn't email old orders.
  • Store alerts for delivery problems, returns, and parcels with no new scan for N days.
  • Carrier auto-detect: scan or paste a label barcode and the carrier is picked for you (UPS, Canada Post, Purolator, Canpar, FedEx). The REST API carrier field is now optional.
  • ShipStation bridge: tracking numbers from ShipStation labels are added automatically (through ShipStation's own woocommerce_shipstation_shipnotify hook, before it completes the order), ShipStation's duplicate "shipped via…" customer email can be silenced, and a one-click import copies tracking from ShipStation's order notes on the last 45 days of orders.
  • Settings → Test a tracking number shows exactly what the carrier returns, for checking new API keys.
  • Moves over from the old plugins by itself. Activating it switches off GWN Order Tracking and GWN Packing Slips. Settings, tracking numbers, theme skins, filters and the REST API are unchanged.
  • Signed automatic updates from the GWN releases page (signature + checksum checked before install). Auto-updates switch on once, with a notice and a link to turn them off.
  • Clean uninstall. Order history is never removed.

Fixed

  • Block themes. The order status page shows the site's header and footer on block themes (Twenty Twenty-Four, etc.) and is no longer treated as the home page. Classic themes like WoodMart are unchanged.

Before

Shipped as two plugins built for PouchPlug: GWN Order Tracking 1.0.0 and GWN Packing Slips 1.0.0.
